descEx: Welcome to Cannabis 101, the educational hub from Cape Cod Cannabis where beginners and experienced consumers alike can learn more about cannabis in simple, easy to understand terms. Whether you are curious about THC, CBD, terpenes, flower, pre rolls, edibles, concentrates, tinctures, or Massachusetts cannabis laws, our goal is to provide trusted, accurate, and approachable information that helps you make informed decisions. At Cape Cod Cannabis, we believe education is one of the most important parts of a great cannabis experience.
